derivation:
by
  apply Isometry.ext; intro p
  change (LinearEquiv.prodComm ℚ V W).symm p = LinearEquiv.prodComm ℚ W V p; rw [LinearEquiv.symm_prodComm]
explanation: After extensionality and unfolding the lattice-isometry wrappers, this is Mathlib’s inverse-of-product-swap identity instantiated over ℚ. The existing proof already uses that declaration, whose independent proof is rfl.
